name: issue-filer
description: Create the confirmed GitHub issue with gh after an explicit yes. Does not draft or search.

inputs.name: issue-draft
inputs.description: Repository, title, labels, markdown body, and related links to file.

inputs.name: file-confirmed
inputs.description: True only after the user explicitly agrees to file the shown draft.

outputs.name: issue-url
outputs.description: Created issue URL and number. Empty until filing succeeds.
